article.story: THIBODAUX, La. -- — Michael Gray Jr. matched his career high with 25 points to guide Nicholls to a 75-67 victory over Houston Christian on Monday night. Gray shot 9 for 14, including 5 for 10 from beyond the arc for the Colonels (14-9, 8-4 Southland Conference). Jamal West totaled 14 and 13 rebounds. Robert Brown III scored 13. Bryson Dawkins led the way for the Huskies (10-13, 7-5) with 21 points and six rebounds. Julian Mackey added 11 points and Elijah Brooks scored 10. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
